pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregularly shaped dark brown polygonal regions exhibiting sharp edge gradients. Patches on the neck are predominantly elongated vertically, while shoulder patches transition into more compact, multi-sided tessellations with high contrast against the lighter interstitial space.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: A continuous network of cream-colored interstitial pathways forming a topological mesh. Junction nodes typically connect three to four pathways, with relatively uniform pixel thickness across the mid-neck and shoulder sections.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: The mane along the dorsal neck presents a fine, low-amplitude serrated profile with high-frequency jaggedness visible against the out-of-focus background.
